reply.text:
Gym fees add up, no argument there. The good news is you don't need a membership to make real progress: a home setup with a pair of adjustable dumbbells, a bench and a pull-up bar covers most of what matters, and bodyweight and outdoor training can carry you further than people expect. The honest tradeoff is that heavy barbell work is harder to replace, so it depends on what you're chasing.

If you want to see what that looks like, tell me what equipment you have or could get, or if you have none, and I'll build you a program around it. Or if you're keeping the membership, I can make sure you're using every session you pay for.
